event_installation.label: Event Installed
event_installation.description: booking_confirmation GA4 event installed on /book/confirmed page
event_installation.evidence_required: Event visible in GA4 DebugView on test booking

event_firing.label: Event Firing
event_firing.description: booking_confirmation fires on every booking confirmation page view
event_firing.evidence_required: Event count > 0 in GA4 Realtime dashboard

service_param_populated.label: Service Parameter
service_param_populated.description: service parameter is populated (not blank) in every event
service_param_populated.evidence_required: service field shows valid values: FULL_BAG_FITTING, COACHING, etc.

value_param_populated.label: Value Parameter
value_param_populated.description: booking_value_proxy is populated with a real number (not 0 or blank)

utm_source_arriving.label: UTM Source Arriving
utm_source_arriving.description: utm_source parameter is captured in the event
utm_source_arriving.evidence_required: utm_source field shows 'instagram', 'google', etc. in event data

utm_medium_arriving.label: UTM Medium Arriving
utm_medium_arriving.description: utm_medium parameter is captured in the event

hook_id_tracking.label: Hook ID Tracking
hook_id_tracking.description: hook_id is present in UTM chain and arriving in events
hook_id_tracking.evidence_required: hook_id appears in utm_content field for IG-sourced bookings

recommendation_id_tracking.label: Recommendation ID Tracking
recommendation_id_tracking.description: recommendation_id is linked to UTM and arriving in events
recommendation_id_tracking.evidence_required: recommendation_id field populated for bookings from tracked campaigns

ga4_reports_visible.label: GA4 Reports Updated
ga4_reports_visible.description: booking_confirmation appears in GA4 Reports → Engagement → Events
ga4_reports_visible.evidence_required: Event visible in GA4 standard reports within 24-48h

dashboard_upgrade.label: Dashboard Upgraded
dashboard_upgrade.description: Marketing dashboard upgrades sources from STRONG_PROXY to VERIFIED_REVENUE

launch_sequence.action: Swing Shack Dev installs booking_confirmation event

launch_sequence.note: Must see event fire before live
Blank params mean tracking is incomplete

launch_sequence.action: Confirm event appears in GA4 Realtime
launch_sequence.note: Watch Realtime dashboard during live booking

launch_sequence.action: Agent detects event firing, upgrades sources

launch_sequence.note: REVENUE TRUTH zone should show verified revenue > 0

minimum_viable: booking_value_proxy is populated with real values
full_attribution: hook_id is linked via UTM chain

if_event_is_not_firing.check_1: Is the /book/confirmed page URL correct? (check GA4 debug view)
if_event_is_not_firing.check_2: Is the gtag script present and loading on the page?
if_event_is_not_firing.check_3: Are there JavaScript errors in the console?
if_event_is_not_firing.check_4: Has GA4 property ID been confirmed correct?
if_event_is_not_firing.check_5: Is the confirmation page URL passing UTM params through?

honest_note: Until booking_confirmation fires with real data, all revenue remains MODELLED. The dashboard will show STRONG_PROXY until this event is live. Do not claim VERIFIED_REVENUE until the event is confirmed firing.
